_comment: Trading rules shared by every trader (DESIGN.md §10), read by Trading, Selling and TraderStock. Each trader's own selling rates are its "sell" block in data/traders/traders.json, its restock time "restock_minutes" there. restock_minutes: how often a trader restocks when it doesn't say (real minutes; the clock runs while the game is closed). min_loyalty: the lowest loyalty level a buy offer may need, by its item's rarity (0: never sold for money, only bartered); checked when offers.json loads. sell_value: what a sold item is worth before the trader's rate: a gun or armor at durability_floor of its value when worn out, up to all of it when new, and upgraded gear upgrade_bonus more per level. confirm: with the confirm_sell_valuables setting on, selling an item of this rarity or better, or with one of these tags, asks first. wanted: each restock every trader wants count (from-to) valuables or barter goods (categories, loot items up to max_rarity) among what it buys and no trader sells for money, paying multiplier times the price for up to per_item of each. exchange: the trader who changes money, and the roubles a dollar costs (buy) and fetches (sell). resale_floor: no discount (a trader's loyalty buy_discount in traders.json, the quick-buy bundle) takes a price below what the best-paying trader pays for the item at their top loyalty level, whole or in parts (a dollar at the exchange's sell rate), plus this share (Trading.price()). barters: the barter rules (data/traders/barters/, BarterTable): a required item Ultra Rare or rarer (valuable_rarity) counts as a valuable whatever its category; a barter giving a Legendary reward (never sold, min_loyalty 0) needs never_sold_level; what a barter asks for is worth at most max_value_ratio times what it gives, and at least that fraction of it. used_stock: the fence's worn gear each restock: count (from-to) items rolled from the Scav kit tables (path: weight), guns and armor at durability (from-to share of new), priced at price times their worn value, one of each; only what his loyalty level could buy from a trader (min_loyalty, and nothing traders sell only from a higher level) and nothing a trader could want, re-rolled otherwise. His loyalty level is your Scav karma's (traders.json karma_levels): each level above 1 adds level_durability to both ends of durability and level_price to the price share (below 0: cheaper), though an item's price share never drops below the most any trader pays for it at their top level plus resale_margin, so nothing he sells can be sold on to a trader at a profit; each point of karma below 0 adds karma_price to the price share and karma_durability to durability.
